name: Open WebUI Computer (Latest Python, No Docker)
install_cmd: ACCOUNT_HOME=$(getent passwd "$(id -u)" 2>/dev/null | awk -F: 'NR==1{print $6}'); [ -d "$ACCOUNT_HOME" ] || ACCOUNT_HOME=/home/$(id -un); mkdir -p "$ACCOUNT_HOME/.cache/webconsole-agent"; HELPER="$ACCOUNT_HOME/.cache/webconsole-agent/install-python-agent.sh"; HELPER_URL=${HELPER_URL:-https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fazilatma/new/main/install-python-agent.sh}; curl -fsSL "$HELPER_URL" -o "$HELPER" || curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fazilatma/new/arena/01a0f230-new/install-python-agent.sh -o "$HELPER"; chmod 700 "$HELPER"; bash "$HELPER" install --home "$ACCOUNT_HOME" --port "${PORT:-8000}" --python "${PYTHON_VERSION:-latest}" --extras "${CPTR_EXTRAS:-base}" --workspace "$PWD" --no-start
start_cmd: ACCOUNT_HOME=$(getent passwd "$(id -u)" 2>/dev/null | awk -F: 'NR==1{print $6}'); [ -d "$ACCOUNT_HOME" ] || ACCOUNT_HOME=/home/$(id -un); exec "$ACCOUNT_HOME/.local/bin/python-agent" run --port "${PORT:-8000}" --workspace "$PWD"
